newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: WILLIAMS DE BROE TO ISSUE GDRS FOR HERMIS.
newsitem.headline: WILLIAMS DE BROE TO ISSUE GDRS FOR HERMIS.

text.p: Lithuania's Hermis Bank said on Monday that it has signed an agreement with the investment bank Williams de Broe to distribute eight million litas of its new share issue as global depository receipts (GDRs).

"Hermis signed an agreement with Williams De Broe which will arrange the remaining eight million litas face value stake in the new share issue in global depository receipts," the chairman of the bank Nadiezhda Novickiene told Reuters.
Novickiene added that Lithuanian brokerage house Vilfima also participated in the deal.
She said that the issue price of the share was 150 litas.
The bank also said that according to the agreement with Williams de Broe, the shares should be issued in GDRs no later than August 1.
The shares are the remaining portion of a 23 million litas new share issue, 65 percent of which was bought by its current shareholders earlier this month.
Hermis said on Friday that its board had decided to distribute part of the new share issue in GDRs, though declined to name the investor.
Hermis Bank's share capital will stand at 90 million litas after the entire 23 million litas share issue is distributed.
Hermis Bank is one of the leaders in the country's banking market and is one of the two banks listed on the elite official list of Vilnius bourse.
